stories.headline: CGNAT Self-Hosting: Exposing Services Behind Carrier-Grade NAT
stories.summary: This guide demonstrates how to bypass CGNAT limitations to self-host services, allowing users to expose their local networks to the internet despite restricted IP addressing.
stories.original_title: I self-host anything I want behind CGNAT, and here's how you can too
stories.why_it_matters: This lets regular people run their own servers and host websites or games directly from home, even when internet providers limit the number of public addresses available. It gives users more control over their digital space and reduces reliance on big tech companies for hosting services.
stories.other_side: Opening your home network to the internet can make it easier for hackers to find and attack your devices if security settings are not perfect. It also puts more responsibility on the user to keep their system safe without professional support.

stories.headline: Foxconn Sales Surge on AI Boom, Reaching $29.14 Billion
stories.summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry reported its second-highest monthly sales in history for August, driven by surging demand from the artificial intelligence sector.
stories.original_title: AI boom lifts Foxconn August sales to $29.14 billion
stories.why_it_matters: Foxconn’s huge sales show that the demand for AI hardware is real and growing fast, which means more jobs and investment in factories making chips and computers. This boom helps push the entire tech supply chain forward and proves AI is moving from hype to actual business revenue.
stories.other_side: Relying so heavily on one industry makes the company vulnerable if AI trends change or slow down suddenly. It also raises concerns about working conditions and environmental impacts from ramping up production so quickly.

stories.headline: The Rise of the CISO in the Age of AI Cybersecurity Threats
stories.summary: Following high-profile agent hacks involving major AI platforms, Chief Information Security Officers are emerging as critical figures in protecting enterprise infrastructure against sophisticated digital threats.
stories.original_title: Meet the CISO: A new front line star in the AI cybersecurity war
stories.why_it_matters: As AI systems become smarter, they also become bigger targets for hackers who want to steal data or cause chaos. Making cybersecurity leaders more powerful ensures that companies have dedicated experts focused solely on stopping these new, complex threats before they happen.
stories.other_side: Giving too much power to security teams might slow down innovation because every new feature needs strict approval. Critics argue this could create a culture of fear where useful AI tools are blocked unnecessarily.

stories.headline: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Review: Flex Mode Obsolescence
stories.summary: A hands-on evaluation reveals that the removal or degradation of Flex Mode on the latest foldable device has a minimal impact on user experience, challenging previous assumptions about its necessity.
stories.original_title: I thought losing Flex Mode would ruin the Galaxy Z Fold 8 — I was completely wrong
stories.why_it_matters: The removal of Flex Mode shows that phone makers are learning what features users actually care about versus those that are just gimmicks. This shift suggests future foldable phones will focus on simpler, more reliable designs rather than complicated hinge mechanics.
stories.other_side: Some loyal fans feel disappointed that a unique selling point was removed, feeling like the product lost its special character. They worry this trend will lead to all phones looking and acting the same, reducing variety in the market.

stories.headline: Global Entry App Replacement Signals DHS Digital Platform Overhaul
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security is retiring its legacy Global Entry mobile application in favor of a modernized Trusted Traveler platform, marking a significant shift in government digital infrastructure.
stories.original_title: The Global Entry mobile app is getting replaced: Here's what to know
stories.why_it_matters: Replacing old government apps with modern platforms makes travel smoother and faster for millions of people by fixing bugs and improving security. It sets a standard for how other agencies should update their technology to serve citizens better.
stories.other_side: Old systems often worked fine for basic tasks, so changing them risks introducing new glitches during the transition. There is also concern that collecting more digital data increases privacy risks for travelers.

stories.headline: Afterworld Game Review: Controversial Moral Freedom in Post-Apocalypse
stories.summary: The new post-apocalyptic title 'Afterworld' sparks debate over its inclusion of extreme moral choices, with developers defending player agency despite public criticism of its dark themes.
stories.original_title: From eating the elderly to selling kids, Afterworld gives you the freedom to do terrible things in the post-apocalypse
stories.why_it_matters: This game highlights how developers are pushing boundaries to let players make difficult moral choices, reflecting real-world ethical dilemmas in a safe space. It encourages players to think critically about consequences and personal values through interactive storytelling.
stories.other_side: Many players find extreme dark themes disturbing or unnecessary, arguing that entertainment should not glorify suffering. Critics say such content can desensitize people to violence or normalize harmful behavior.

stories.headline: DeFi Hidden Credit Risks from Tax Optimization Strategies
stories.summary: An analysis of decentralized finance reveals how popular tax strategies like 'buy, borrow, die' are inadvertently loading DeFi pools with hidden credit risks derived from digital asset leverage.
stories.original_title: How the “buy, borrow, die” tax trade is quietly loading DeFi pools with hidden credit risk
stories.why_it_matters: Hidden credit risks in decentralized finance mean that small problems could quickly turn into big financial crashes if many people try to withdraw at once. Understanding this helps investors avoid losing money when popular strategies fail under pressure.
stories.other_side: Some argue that these risks are part of the natural high-reward nature of crypto markets and that users should accept potential losses. Others believe regulation would stifle innovation and hurt the growth of decentralized finance.

stories.headline: WordPress Plugin Author Requests Persian Translation Access
stories.summary: A developer for a WooCommerce payment plugin formally requests permission to access translation resources for the Persian language, highlighting ongoing localization efforts within the WordPress ecosystem.
stories.original_title: [Wordpress.org] Hello Polyglots team, — I am the plugin author of Weblogbaz Card to Card Payment for WooCommerce and I would like to request PTE access for Persian (fa_IR) for this plugin. Plugin: Weblogbaz Card to Card Payment for WooCommerce Plugin slug: weblogbaz-card-to-card-payment Translation…
stories.why_it_matters: Allowing Persian translations helps millions of non-English speakers use online stores easily, expanding the reach of e-commerce globally. It promotes inclusivity by ensuring language barriers do not stop people from participating in the digital economy.
stories.other_side: Managing multiple languages adds complexity and cost for developers, potentially slowing down updates for core features. Some worry that poor-quality automatic translations could confuse customers and damage brand reputation.

stories.headline: Iran Claims Military Superiority Amid Technological Disparity
stories.summary: Senior Iranian military officials assert that their forces possess sufficient willpower and endurance to counter enemies equipped with superior global military technology, framing modern warfare as a battle of resilience.
stories.original_title: Iran stands against an enemy with top military technology: Senior commander
stories.why_it_matters: Iran’s claims highlight the ongoing tension in the Middle East and how smaller nations try to balance military strength with limited resources. This narrative influences regional alliances and global powers’ decisions on how to engage diplomatically or militarily.
stories.other_side: Skeptics argue that claiming superiority without matching technology is dangerous and could lead to miscalculated conflicts. It may also distract from internal economic struggles and human rights issues within the country.

stories.headline: Ukrainian Universities Secured European Grants for Engineering Tech
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence supports technical universities in obtaining European research grants aimed at developing engineering competencies and enhancing institutional capacity for technological innovation.
stories.original_title: Ministry of Defence supports Ukrainian universities in securing European grants to develop engineering competencies
stories.why_it_matters: Funding engineering research in Ukraine helps rebuild critical infrastructure and train skilled workers needed for long-term recovery and innovation. It strengthens ties between Europe and Ukraine, showing commitment to supporting democratic institutions amid conflict.
stories.other_side: Some question whether diverting funds to universities takes away from immediate humanitarian needs like food and shelter. There are also concerns about corruption or inefficiency in how these grants are managed locally.
